title: Barycentric Weak Inner-Product Gromov-Wasserstein
translated_title: 重心弱内积格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的重心弱内积格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离，通过条件均值匹配源关系与目标条件分布，解决了传统GW在一对多场景中的敏感性，并证明了其与均值保持扩展的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a barycentric weak inner-product Gromov-Wasserstein distance that matches source relations with target conditional means, addressing sensitivity in one-to-many settings and establishing its connection to mean-preserving spreads.
